title: Chinna Vathiyar
desc: A scientist gets into trouble when he develops a formula that enables the soul to move out of a body and enter the person or animal present in proximity.

title: Mappillai Thevai
desc: Bhoomi, a businesswoman, is reluctant to get married and settle down. However, everything changes when her mother introduces her to Aakash.

title: Vettaiyaadu Vilaiyaadu
desc: DCP Raghavan tries to catch the killers of Rani, the daughter of a police officer. Following this, many more murders take place, leading him to New York to capture the maniac killers.

title: Mercury Pookkal
desc: Two people get married due to pressure from their respective families. Eventually, they fall in love with each other, but a new challenge awaits their marriage.

title: Ezhumalai
desc: Ezhumalai struggles against enemies and his past while he protects his village and searches for tranquility. But everything changes when Anjali enters his life with an unexpected choice.
